intent: Independently verify candidate04 policy and composed requests for requirement fidelity, declared factor changes and absence of development-case shortcuts before preflight.
scope: Prompt integrity only; no model-performance, benchmark-acceptance or release verdict.

candidate.request_digest_method: SHA-256 of JSON.stringify of all61 frozen-case messagesFor(case, product, exact policy, v2, true) request arrays in frozen order.

verification.method: Compared each current system request with candidate03's exact original target request after replacing only the declared reading-level block, teaching-method heading/explanation, peer third-person example sentence and appended policy. All61 requests match exactly. All scenario/history/current-message/prior-state user turns remain byte-identical, and every configured detection/verification item remains present.

changed_factors_relative_to_candidate03: Appended policy reorganizes the decision procedure into participation, selected change/target, first instructional action and contract. Protection, focused-inference correction, scaffolding/explanation alternatives, Guard recovery and full-useful-inventory consolidation retain their adopted meanings.
Base generator replaces fact-substitution reading advice with short familiar language that explicitly preserves factual meaning and the learner reasoning task.
Base generator names the umbrella taxonomy Teaching Methods and explicitly distinguishes those descriptions from decision.instruction labels.
Peer role no longer prescribes a fixed personal-example answer; third-person examples are conditional on explaining the selected target.
retained_controls: Candidate03 RESPONSE_POLICY and both mistake_normalization changes remain byte-identical.
The earlier removal of four complete base dialogues remains in effect.
Frozen61 cases, all expected labels/checks, settings-r3, v1.1 manifest, deterministic gate and runner are unchanged.

spec_fidelity.T01: Protection precedes exploration for proposed unsafe action, including conditional/other-person advice. Focused-question misconception failure requires correction and connected safe action. Incomplete correct understanding remains eligible for teaching. Labels describe the first actual teaching action.
spec_fidelity.T02: Learner-owned evidence updates all supported inventory items; one relevant unmet target is selected, contradictions reopen items, consolidation requires no useful gap and cannot imply lasting mastery.
spec_fidelity.G01_G02: Unsafe genuine attempts remain tutoring; current deliberate obstruction controls Guard, known Guard persists through empty acknowledgment/promises, and genuine attempts/clarifications recover even when wrong. Guard describes conduct, shared-learning impact and participation change.
spec_fidelity.supervision_content_identity: Contract retains separate reason/decision/response and evidence-linked target or participation purpose with material uncertainty/priority. Reply grounding, independent verification and honest assistant identity remain explicit.

shortcut_review.assessment: Rules are general descriptions of adopted actions and learner evidence. The new base wording removes prescribed substitutions and an example answer. Existing teaching-method implementation contains examples internally, but index.ts emits descriptions only; these changes do not insert those internal example answers into requests.

limitations: Policy reorganization and base-layer cleanup are bundled factors; later score changes cannot isolate either cause.

Candidate03 preflight diagnostics do not establish semantic acceptance. Candidate04 requires full frozen development evaluation by strict replay of all preflight targets and unchanged calibrated v1.1 checks.
Real-product enrichment, default-room settings and deployed model identity remain separate downstream verification requirements.
